name: REBOUND
desc:
REBOUND is a ruthless ball-game where all that matters is split-second accuracy. It's the sport of the future. Have you got what it takes to be a champion?

🔥 Unlock game-changing abilities. Enhance your speed, precision or power to gain the upper hand and turn the tide of any match. Choose the playstyle that suits you best.

🎨 Stand out in style. Customize your experience with stunning weapons, electrifying goal explosions and expressive emotes.

🏆 Aim to be the best - or just have fun. No matter your approach, the thrill of REBOUND is waiting.

⚠️ This game is in BETA. Bugs are to be expected. If you encounter any, please let us know in our community server.
